opening.argument: The video is presented as Bangla technical analysis of Facebook page monetization policy, not as an offer of financial benefit. Its title identifies “Facebook Page MONETIZATION” and “Facebook MONETIZATION Policy 2020,” while the channel description characterizes the content as “technical videos in Bangla.” The discussion addresses whether viewers should make modifications to a Facebook page and considers monetization-related consequences, including the statement, “I'm going to tell you why you're not going to do any modifications on your Facebook page.” References to following the channel or social accounts are ordinary channel engagement, and the discussion of uploading Facebook-related videos to a channel or website is operational guidance rather than a condition for receiving money.
